lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What an odd combination.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What is this? I thought you said we were surrounded. A bit of an exaggeration, don't you think?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Three second generation Grimms models are more than enough to hem you in.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hansel, Gretel, and Siren.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Seems like you haven't come here to talk things through.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Tell me, why are you here?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: We're here to take you in,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: and to eliminate the Heretic Anachiro.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Then I'm afraid you wasted your trip,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: since the Heretic Anachiro is no more.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Allow me to convey the current feelings of the Central Government.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You massacred untold numbers of Nikkes and humans.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Destroyed the Heretic Research Lab.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Murdered Red Shoes in cold blood.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You must be executed.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Given the untold harm you have caused on humankind, both physically and on morale,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: we are here to kill you and secure your remains.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The news of your death will boost morale.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Hmph. I hate to admit it, but you're not wrong.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Furthermore, any future option to capture or negotiate with Anachiro is off the table.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Our primary goal is elimination.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Isn't that going a bit overboard? A Heretic's body holds untold research potential.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Too many have died by her hand.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: It's not just the Central Government. The common people harbor a desire for revenge.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: So many of them have lost family and friends.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: ... So she's become a figurehead.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Raptures are already starting to be viewed as a natural phenomenon, akin to a natural disaster.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: There is no trace of individuality amongst them. They are an anonymous collective, a faceless horde.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: But the Heretic Anachiro?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: She is one person.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: A perfect and singular target to focus on.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: So you came to kill her?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And you brought them along?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: There is nothing better than a Grimms model to combat a Heretic.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Hey. You guys.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What's gotten into you?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Did you really come to kill Cinderella?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: They're all in a bit of a tight spot.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Their top member, Cinderella, has been corrupted.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Red Shoes, once a high-ranking priest and researcher from V.T.C., is dead.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Siren is barely able to control the immense power she wields.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: As for Hansel and Gretel...

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: They are illicit creations.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Only three second generation Grimms models were supposed to be made: Cinderella, Red Shoes, and Siren.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Hansel and Gretel were created by you without prior authorization.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You created full-fledged Nikkes all in secret.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You know what this implies, don't you?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: That I'm amazing?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: ... I won't deny that, but it also casts doubt upon your intentions. Only a potential traitor would conduct such actions in secret.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The Heretic is a new weapon that you created, and the second generation Grimms models were all made to eventually serve as such.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: It makes for a convenient cover-up, and you're the perfect scapegoat.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: If you had a brain in your head, you'd know that's complete horsesh...

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: My opinion doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: What matters is that this is what most people will think.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: In particular, those who are in power.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So what are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Cinderella.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: If you die, everyone else can be cleared of their charges.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: If you take the blame for what's happened, and die,

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Abe and the other Grimms models can return.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: They can be humanity's saviors once again. The successors to the Goddesses.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Only you will be considered a traitor.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: To capture you, the second generation Grimms models were deployed.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: After a fierce battle, they emerged victorious.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The foe that even the Goddess Squad struggled against will be defeated. Vengeance will be ours.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: It would be a grand achievement, one which overshadows any minor details.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... I understand what you're saying.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: But I have no intention of cooperating.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: There is something I must do.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will defeat the Queen.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: ... I see. Given your specifications, this is not as outlandish as it may sound.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Very well. Is this your final decision?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: I should have known this is what you'd all decide.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hansel, Gretel, Siren. Let's go together.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: With your help, we can win.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I want to ask you something.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Did Anachiro kill Red Shoes?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... No. I did.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Why did you kill her?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: She deserved to die.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I thought Red Shoes was kind.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She took good care of us.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She was kind to Siren.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: She liked Cinderella.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Was your hate for Red Shoes so strong as to forget all that?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes. I despised her.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: If you start to hate Gretel and me, will you kill us too?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: If you do something like what Red Shoes did, then yes.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will kill you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: What were Red Shoes' final words?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: She didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Oswald told me that

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: she was refining the corruption virus.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: I did some of my own investigating.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Turns out Red Shoes was using an old V.T.C. research lab in secret.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: We found over 200 Nikkes and about 10 Raptures there.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The Nikkes all had their brains operated on, and the Raptures had been implanted with Corruption.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: ... Is that true?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: All the Nikkes were dead, but something stood out even more than that.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: All their eyes were red.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The Raptures were all functioning normally.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: They had been stripped of their armor and were immobile.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Only the Corruption-inducing devices were operational.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Red Shoes was refining the Corruption process. Of that, there is no doubt.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: And one more thing.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: The entire lab was full of your photos.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I knew that Red Shoes did some bad things,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: and even worse things to Cinderella.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: But did you have to kill her?

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Was there no other option?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: No, there wasn't.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: I think you're trying to play it off like you don't care.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel thinks you're crying.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We both like you, Cinderella.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We also liked Red Shoes.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We're...

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Sad. Red Shoes was like family to us, and now she's gone.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm sad too.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We don't want to lose another family member,

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: so we will protect you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: We will protect Cinderella.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Let's go together.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... Thank you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Can I hug you?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Sure.
Hansel and Gretel approach Cinderella.
Without a word, the two hug Cinderella tightly.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: ... Sorry.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: For not believing in what you said.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: For not believing you.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: gretel
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: ... It's okay.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Thank you for coming to meet me.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Thank you for... forgiving me.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: You did nothing wrong.
Cinderella gently pats Hansel and Gretel on the back, then slowly walks towards Little Mermaid.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ahh... Ahhhhh...
Cinderella quietly extends her hand to Little Mermaid.
Little Mermaid silently regards Cinderella's extended hand, then reaches out her own in response.
The two hands intertwine.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah, ah... Ahhhhh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Cinderella.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You were... hurting...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You were... very lonely...

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You fool. I told you not to talk.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I was... so scared.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I didn't know if the person in front of me was the real you.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I was scared that you might hurt me again.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I avoided your hand.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You probably just wanted to hold hands.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: No one would have held Cinderella's hand.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You're holding my hand now. That's all I need.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: ... I understand.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Dang. I didn't even need to persuade them.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Oswald.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Are you crying?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: You didn't come here to kill us, did you?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: I was sent here to eliminate you. That much is true.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: But I failed.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: And here you are practically laying down the red carpet to let us escape.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: ... Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: So are you going to kill the Queen?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Then you are officially fugitives now.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Your names will have a curse upon them, and you will be shunned. Can you handle that?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: It's okay. We can always clear our names again.

lines.speaker: hansel
lines.text: Gretel and I are okay with it.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Aaah.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Here.
Oswald hands Abe a small tablet.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: A list of safe places and routes that will keep you out of harm's way.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Perhaps it will come in handy.

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: abe
lines.text: It's unlike you.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: I'm a fan.
Oswald extends his hand and points off into the distance.
He points to a gigantic pillar stretching from the horizon up into the far reaches of the sky. The Lift.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: You have to win.

lines.speaker: oswald_o
lines.text: Give humanity the victory they deserve.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Leave it to us.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I will bring you a splendid, beautiful victory.
